routes.name: Entry visa (via Yemeni embassy)
routes.summary: Yemen requires a visa for nationals of many countries. The Yemeni embassy in the Netherlands says new entry visa requests are on hold. Only people of Yemeni origin, international organization staff, journalists and diplomats are being issued visas.

other: Invitation from Yemen's Immigration, Passport & Naturalization Authority and from the hosting entity.
Letter stating the purpose of the visit and your address in Yemen.
Passport valid at least 6 months, photo, application form, medical fitness certificate.
Details come from one embassy page for the Netherlands, Norway and Sweden. Other embassies may differ. No central official eVisa page was confirmed, so check your nearest Yemeni embassy.

fees.label: Entry visa (Embassy of Yemen in the Netherlands)

routes.processing: About 2 weeks per the embassy, but it depends on approval from Yemeni authorities.
